create.name: Bhavani Lorraine Nelson
create.bio:
Bhavani Lorraine Nelson is a meditation teacher, chant leader and singer who has taught in the Kripalu tradition since arriving at Kripalu in 1988. Her first career was in the voice: classical vocal training, theatre and opera work, radio, choirs and later many years teaching public speaking. Alongside it ran a long spiritual search that took her from singing in churches to Eastern contemplative practice, and at Kripalu she went deep into yoga, pranayama, meditation and the Sanskrit chanting she had first met through Ram Dass in 1970. Among those she counts as her teachers are Yogi Amrit Desai, the insight meditation teachers Sharon Salzberg, Joseph Goldstein, Ruth Denison and Sylvia Boorstein, and the mantra teachers Thomas Ashley-Farrand and Russill Paul.

She is a professional-level Kripalu Yoga teacher and has led meditation and chanting programmes at Kripalu and in several countries, with a gift for making practice clear to beginners. Today much of her teaching happens online: a free Monday evening meditation group that sits together and then discusses a reading, and a free Wednesday session of Sanskrit call-and-response chanting. Her recorded course introduces six classic concentration practices so students can find the one that suits them. She also offers private sessions in meditation, chanting and the voice, and is releasing a series of slow devotional chants in several languages as single downloads.

courses.title: Gateways to Meditation: Exploring Six Concentration Practices
courses.description: A recorded six-session video course for beginners, each session introducing a different concentration practice, starting with awareness of the breath and walking meditation. Students practise each method between sessions to find the one that suits them, with handouts for some sessions.
courses.price: $120 for the video series (six months of access) or $25 / session

courses.title: One-on-One Sessions with Bhavani
courses.description: Private sessions in meditation and chanting, as well as voice lessons and coaching for singing or speaking. Arranged by email.

courses.title: The Soothing Series (chant recordings)
courses.description: Unhurried devotional chants and songs, some traditional and some written by her or her friends, sung in six languages including Sanskrit, Pali and Hebrew. They are released one track at a time as downloads for quiet listening and meditation.

free_resources.title: Monday Evening Zoom Meditation Sangha
free_resources.description: A weekly online group on Mondays at 7 pm Eastern that sits in silence for forty minutes, then shares a reading brought by a participant and talks it over. Any form of silent meditation is welcome; donations are optional.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Evening Zoom Chanting
free_resources.description: Weekly Sanskrit call-and-response chanting on Zoom in the Kripalu tradition, Wednesdays at 7 pm Eastern. The chants change each week and members receive an email with the words and a short article; donations are optional.
